guard_streams.source: March 2026: Premises contracted and built under Project Gigabit contracts
guard_streams.write_limit: Monthly contract-management information is rounded, may omit deferred scope, is subject to ingestion lag and is not directly comparable with official statistics; it cannot establish current selected-parcel coverage or measured speed.

facts.detail: The March 2026 contract-management page was updated on 20 July 2026.
The release reports monthly contract-level Project Gigabit progress.
The contracted-premises field covers initial contract scope and may exclude deferred scope.
CO denotes Type C Call Off contracts.
The management-information release is not directly comparable with BDUK official statistics.
The table is a snapshot of BDUK data on 17 March 2026.
The page records a variable lag between delivery or signature and data ingestion.
The figures should not be used to assess contractual milestones.
The March figures are rounded to the nearest 10.
The March table totals 1,020,160 contracted premises and 227,310 built contracted premises.

facts.detail: The April 2026 contract-management page was updated on 20 July 2026.
BDUK describes the page as monthly contract-level Project Gigabit data.
The contracted premises field includes initial scope only and may omit deferred scope.
CO means Type C Call Off contract.
The release is not directly comparable with official statistics on subsidy-attributable delivery.
The table is a snapshot of BDUK data on 22 April 2026.
The page warns of variable ingestion lag after contract signature or delivery.
The April figures should not be used to judge contractual milestones.
The April data is rounded to the nearest 10 and totals may not sum exactly.
The April table totals 1,047,200 contracted premises and 250,000 built contracted premises.
